lines.en: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for coming to the meeting.
lines.zh: 大家早安，謝謝大家來開會。

lines.en: First, the sales report is ready, and the numbers are very good.
lines.zh: 首先，銷售報告做好了，數字非常好。

lines.en: Second, a new customer will visit our office on Friday.
lines.zh: 第二，有一位新客戶星期五會來我們辦公室。

lines.en: Please bring your samples to the meeting room before lunch.
lines.zh: 請在午餐前把你們的樣品帶到會議室。

lines.en: After this meeting, I will send everyone the new schedule.
lines.zh: 開完會後，我會把新的時間表寄給大家。

questions.en: What good news does the speaker give?
questions.zh: 說話的人宣布了什麼好消息？

questions.en: When will the customer visit?
questions.zh: 客戶什麼時候會來？

questions.en: What will the speaker send after the meeting?
questions.zh: 說話的人開完會後會寄什麼？

lines.en: Attention, passengers. Flight 208 to Seattle is late because of the weather.
lines.zh: 各位旅客請注意，往西雅圖的 208 班機因為天氣而延誤。

lines.en: The new leaving time is six forty, from gate twelve.
lines.zh: 新的起飛時間是六點四十分，從 12 號登機門出發。

lines.en: Please do not leave your bags alone at the gate.
lines.zh: 請不要把行李單獨放在登機門。

lines.en: If you need a hotel, please go to the service desk near gate ten.
lines.zh: 如果您需要旅館，請到 10 號登機門附近的服務櫃檯。

lines.en: We are sorry for the trouble.
lines.zh: 造成不便，我們深感抱歉。

questions.en: Why is the flight late?
questions.zh: 班機為什麼延誤？

questions.en: What is the new leaving time?
questions.zh: 新的起飛時間是什麼時候？

questions.en: What can passengers do near gate ten?
questions.zh: 旅客可以在 10 號登機門附近做什麼？

lines.en: Hello, this is the front desk at the City Hotel. I am calling about your reservation for next week.
lines.zh: 您好，這裡是市區飯店的櫃檯。我打來是要談您下週的訂房。

lines.en: Our pool will be closed on Tuesday, but the restaurant will stay open.
lines.zh: 我們的游泳池星期二會關閉，但餐廳照常營業。

lines.en: If you want to change your room, please call us before Monday.
lines.zh: 如果您想換房間，請在星期一以前打電話給我們。

lines.en: Thank you, and have a good day.
lines.zh: 謝謝您，祝您有美好的一天。

questions.en: Why is the speaker calling?
questions.zh: 說話的人為什麼打電話？

questions.en: What will be closed on Tuesday?
questions.zh: 星期二什麼會關閉？

lines.en: Welcome to the first day of training. Please sit down and open the folder on your desk.
lines.zh: 歡迎來到訓練的第一天。請坐下，打開你桌上的資料夾。

lines.en: Inside, you will find a map of the building and a list of rules.
lines.zh: 裡面有大樓的地圖和一份規則清單。

lines.en: At ten o'clock, we will have a short break, and coffee will be in the hall.
lines.zh: 十點我們會休息一下，咖啡會放在大廳。

lines.en: After the break, each person will learn how to use the new computer system.
lines.zh: 休息之後，每個人會學習怎麼使用新的電腦系統。

questions.en: What should the new workers do first?
questions.zh: 新進員工一開始應該做什麼？

questions.en: What will happen after the break?
questions.zh: 休息之後會發生什麼事？
options: A map will be given out.
People will learn a computer system.

lines.en: Good afternoon, and welcome to our warehouse. Today you will see how we send our products.
lines.zh: 午安，歡迎來到我們的倉庫。今天各位會看到我們怎麼出貨。

lines.en: Please wear the safety glasses and stay with the group at all times.
lines.zh: 請戴上安全眼鏡，並且隨時跟著團體。

lines.en: We will walk through three rooms, and the tour will end in the front office.
lines.zh: 我們會走過三個房間，參觀會在前面的辦公室結束。

lines.en: If you have a question, please ask me at any time.
lines.zh: 如果有問題，隨時都可以問我。

questions.en: What must the visitors wear?
questions.zh: 參觀的人必須戴什麼？

questions.en: Where will the tour end?
questions.zh: 參觀會在哪裡結束？

lines.en: Attention, customers. Our big sale starts today and ends on Sunday.
lines.zh: 各位顧客請注意，我們的大特賣今天開始，到星期日結束。

lines.en: All shirts and shoes are half price on the second floor.
lines.zh: 二樓所有的襯衫和鞋子都是半價。

lines.en: Customers who spend over one hundred dollars will get a free bag.
lines.zh: 消費超過一百美元的顧客可以得到一個免費的袋子。

lines.en: Please pay at any desk near the door.
lines.zh: 請在門口附近任何一個櫃檯付款。

questions.en: When does the sale end?
questions.zh: 特賣什麼時候結束？

questions.en: What is half price?
questions.zh: 什麼東西是半價？

questions.en: How can a customer get a free bag?
questions.zh: 顧客要怎樣才能得到免費的袋子？

lines.en: Hello, this is the supplier calling about your order of fifty boxes.
lines.zh: 您好，我是供應商，打來是要談您訂的五十個箱子。

lines.en: Our truck has a problem, so the delivery will come on Wednesday, not Tuesday.
lines.zh: 我們的卡車出了問題，所以送貨會在星期三到，不是星期二。

lines.en: The price will not change, and we will not charge you for shipping.
lines.zh: 價格不會改變，運費我們也不會跟您收。

lines.en: Please call me back before noon if Wednesday is a problem.
lines.zh: 如果星期三不方便，請在中午前回電給我。

questions.en: What is the speaker calling about?
questions.zh: 說話的人打電話是為了什麼？

questions.en: Why is the delivery late?
questions.zh: 送貨為什麼會晚？

questions.en: What should the customer do before noon?
questions.zh: 客戶在中午前應該做什麼？
options: Call back if there is a problem.

lines.en: Welcome to the trade fair. The main hall opens at nine o'clock.
lines.zh: 歡迎來到商展。主展廳九點開放。

lines.en: Please take your name card at the front desk and wear it at all times.
lines.zh: 請在服務台領取您的名牌，並且隨時配戴。

lines.en: Lunch is in room six from twelve to one.
lines.zh: 午餐在六號房間，從十二點到一點。

lines.en: At three o'clock, there will be a talk about new computers in room five.
lines.zh: 三點在五號房間有一場關於新電腦的演講。

questions.en: Where can visitors get a name card?
questions.zh: 參觀者可以在哪裡拿到名牌？

questions.en: What will happen at three o'clock?
questions.zh: 三點會發生什麼事？

lines.en: Welcome to the company, everyone. I want to explain a few rules about the office.
lines.zh: 歡迎大家加入公司。我想說明幾項辦公室的規則。

lines.en: Parking is free, but you must use the lot behind the building.
lines.zh: 停車是免費的，但你們必須停在大樓後面的停車場。

lines.en: Please turn off your computer and the lights when you leave.
lines.zh: 離開時請關掉你的電腦和電燈。

lines.en: If you are sick, call me before eight o'clock in the morning.
lines.zh: 如果你生病了，請在早上八點前打電話給我。

lines.en: I hope you enjoy your first week.
lines.zh: 希望你們喜歡第一個星期。

questions.en: Where should people park?
questions.zh: 大家應該把車停在哪裡？

questions.en: What should a sick worker do?
questions.zh: 生病的員工應該怎麼做？

lines.en: Good evening, everyone, and thank you for joining our company dinner.
lines.zh: 各位晚安，謝謝大家參加我們的公司晚宴。

lines.en: This year, our company made more products and found many new customers.
lines.zh: 今年我們公司生產了更多產品，也找到許多新客戶。

lines.en: I want to thank the sales team, who worked very hard.
lines.zh: 我要感謝業務團隊，他們非常努力。

lines.en: Before we eat, we will give a prize to the best worker of the year.
lines.zh: 用餐之前，我們要頒獎給今年最優秀的員工。

lines.en: Please enjoy the food, and stay for the music later.
lines.zh: 請好好享用餐點，也請留下來聽稍後的音樂。

questions.en: What is the event?
questions.zh: 這是什麼活動？

questions.en: What will happen before the meal?
questions.zh: 用餐之前會發生什麼事？
options: A new product will be shown.
